bundle.shortDescription: A fluid activity island for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Island is a spring-animated pill at the edge of your screen that shows what is happening right now: Claude Code sessions with inline permission answers, music, downloads, timers, screenshots, the clipboard and system events.
